cases.behavior: A named current-format access must preserve transparent legacy migration without scanning unrelated changes.
cases.reproduction: Baseline 053 / 2999b60d. The execution report records paired public CLI timing and precise source-boundary checks; only explicitly recorded old-fail/new-pass cases establish that level of reproduction.
cases.expected: A named current-format access must preserve transparent legacy migration without scanning unrelated changes.
cases.forbidden: Scanning unrelated named changes on the steady path, hiding an unsettled journal, trusting a wrong fence or reusing an unstable observation.
cases.rootCause: Repeated preparation, observation or serialization across the documented boundary; existing safety and recovery contracts must remain authoritative.

tests.namePattern: migrates only the named legacy runtime without enumerating unrelated changes
requiredNames: Native artifact root safety migrates only the named legacy runtime without enumerating unrelated changes

tests.namePattern: retries a transient fence publication observation with a bounded fresh read
requiredNames: workspace runtime resolution and migration retries a transient fence publication observation with a bounded fresh read

tests.namePattern: does not reuse an unstable fence after its bounded publication retries
requiredNames: workspace runtime resolution and migration does not reuse an unstable fence after its bounded publication retries

cases.behavior: A confirmed stopped legacy migration can retire its recovery meta-lock without probing a PID.
cases.reproduction: Place an old nonce/createdAt record at .runtime-migration-recovery.lock and resolve the Runtime root with and without confirmedOwnerStopped.
cases.expected: Unconfirmed recovery preserves the record; confirmed recovery completes; an active transaction still blocks.
cases.forbidden: Permanent legacy-lock failure after confirmation, or takeover of an active transaction.
cases.rootCause: The outer migration recovery lock did not receive the existing stop confirmation.

tests.namePattern: ^(?:recovers a legacy migration recovery lock only after the original operation is confirmed stopped|preserves an active migration recovery transaction even when recovery is confirmed)$
requiredNames: recovers a legacy migration recovery lock only after the original operation is confirmed stopped
preserves an active migration recovery transaction even when recovery is confirmed
